Payout of 13 August is short ₹1,801.00.
The bank credited ₹1,85,196.21 against an expected ₹1,86,997.21. 17 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with chargeback cb_00004 of ₹1,801.00, raised 11 August. The gateway debits a disputed amount when it receives the dispute, but books it against the cycle in which the dispute is later confirmed, so the two can fall in different payouts.
Suggested action: confirm chargeback cb_00004 against this payout and record the dispute in the books. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- cb_00004 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
